title: What Life Dashboard Frameworks Is
definition: Life Dashboard Frameworks: dashboards for running your life.
description:
Strip Life Dashboard Frameworks to its essence and you get dashboards for running your life. Simple to say, civilizational to build.

The path runs through Future Software Paradigms: first metric widgets understanding, then framework logistics prototypes, then goal tracking operations at scale. Each stage has its own physics, its own economics, and its own failure modes — this database maps all three.

Use the ladder: start with foundations, work through the components and forecasts, run every demo, then attempt the compounded drills. By the final record you will hold a working mental model of framework hulls, grounded in real research and honest about what remains unknown.

t: Real Research Today: Life Dashboard Frameworks
title: Real Research Today: Life Dashboard Frameworks
definition: Today's documented research behind Life Dashboard Frameworks.
description:
The road to Life Dashboard Frameworks is already being paved. Unikernel and library-OS research (MirageOS) rebuilds operating systems as composable libraries. Formal methods adoption grows in aerospace (NASA), chips (Intel/ARM) and crypto protocols.

WebAssembly brings sandboxed near-native code to every browser and edge device. Together these programs form the metric widgets foundation that Life Dashboard Frameworks will build on — the framework logistics results, the goal tracking methods, and the institutional memory.

Forecasts are projections, not promises: the dated milestones in this database reflect published roadmaps and expert surveys, and they will move as framework logistics research advances. Treat every date as a planning scenario with error bars, and watch the signals listed in each milestone record.

title: Readiness Estimator: Life Dashboard Frameworks
definition: Estimates Life Dashboard Frameworks readiness from component maturity.
description:
The estimator scores the six Life Dashboard Frameworks components on the TRL 1–9 scale and averages them into a verdict: research phase, pilot phase, or deployment phase. Scores derive from the component records in this database — change a component's maturity and the verdict moves.

Honest scoring is the point: a framework hulls that averages TRL 3 is not failing, it is three phases from deployment, and the estimator tells you which component drags the average down. Fund that one first.

title: Life Dashboard Frameworks Systems Simulator
definition: Simulates Life Dashboard Frameworks operating for a day.
description:
The simulator walks a Life Dashboard Frameworks installation through six operating steps, with seeded randomness standing in for real-world variation. Seed 90991 reproduces this exact run — change the seed in the program to explore other days.

Watch for DEGRADED steps: they mark where metric widgets monitoring, framework logistics redundancy, or goal tracking maintenance would intervene in a real deployment. A simulator that never degrades is lying; this one degrades about eight percent of the time, like early hardware does.

title: Life Dashboard Frameworks Master Roadmap
definition: The united roadmap for Life Dashboard Frameworks: prove, build, operate, compound.
description:
The master roadmap for Life Dashboard Frameworks — dashboards for running your life.

Phase 1 — Prove (metric widgets): laboratory demonstrations of every component, replicated independently. No scaling until the physics is boring.

Phase 2 — Build (framework logistics): pilot manufacturing and integration. The six pieces meet for the first time and the interfaces get honest.

Phase 3 — Operate (goal tracking): continuous real-world operation. Uptime, cost curves and failure data replace projections.

Phase 4 — Compound (data ownership): framework hulls as everyday infrastructure. Costs collapse, standards settle, and consumers-scale deployment begins.

Public edition: phases follow documented research readiness. This record unites the database: overview, research, components, milestones, demos and drills all point here.
